title: The Mediating Role of Relationship-Related Cognitive Distortion on Depression and Perceived Loneliness in Older Adults: A Comparative Study.
summary:
PURPOSE: To compare levels of depression, perceived loneliness, and relationship-related cognitive distortion in older adults living alone and with their families in rural areas, and determine the mediating relationship between relationship-related cognitive distortion and depression and loneliness.
METHOD: Participants comprised 193 older adults, with 105 living alone and 88 living with their families. Data were collected using a Personal Information Form, the Geriatric Depression Scale-Short Form (GDS-15), Interpersonal Cognitive Distortions Scale, and Loneliness Scale for the Elderly (LSFE).
RESULTS: Participants living alone scored significantly higher on the GDS-15 (t = 6.064, p = .001) and LSFE (t = 4.727, p = .001) than participants living with their families. Geriatric depression levels significantly predicted cognitive distortion levels (β = 0.7849, p < .001); however, the effect of cognitive distortion levels on loneliness was not statistically significant (β = 0.0325, p = .2121).
CONCLUSION: Depression and loneliness levels of participants living alone were higher than those of participants living with their families. Participants living alone did not tend to establish close relationships.

标题：关系相关认知扭曲在老年人抑郁与感知孤独感中的中介作用：一项比较研究
摘要：目的：比较农村地区独居与与家人同住的老年人抑郁、感知孤独感和关系相关认知扭曲的水平，并探讨关系相关认知扭曲在抑郁与孤独感之间的中介关系。
方法：研究对象包括193名老年人，其中105人独居，88人与家人同住。数据通过个人信息表、老年抑郁量表简版（GDS-15）、人际认知扭曲量表和老年人孤独感量表（LSFE）收集。
结果：独居参与者在GDS-15（t = 6.064，p = .001）和LSFE（t = 4.727，p = .001）上的得分显著高于与家人同住的参与者。老年抑郁水平显著预测认知扭曲水平（β = 0.7849，p < .001）；然而，认知扭曲水平对孤独感的影响不显著（β = 0.0325，p = .2121）。
结论：独居参与者的抑郁和孤独感水平高于与家人同住的参与者。独居参与者倾向于不建立紧密关系。
关键词：抑郁；孤独感；认知扭曲；老年人；社会关系

title: Comparison of Negative Automatic Thoughts and Self-Efficacy Levels in Mental Disorders.
summary:
PURPOSE: To compare the levels of negative automatic thoughts (NATs) and self-efficacy among individuals with different mental disorders and examine the relationship between NATs and self-efficacy levels across the sample.
METHOD: This cross-sectional study was conducted with 187 individuals diagnosed with bipolar disorder, depression, schizophrenia and other psychotic disorders, anxiety, and substance use disorder (SUD) who attended a psychiatry outpatient clinic. Data were collected using the Negative Automatic Thoughts Questionnaire (NATQ) and General Self-Efficacy Scale (GSE).
RESULTS: Mean GSE total score of individuals with SUD and schizophrenia and other psychotic disorders was lower and mean NATQ total score was higher than other groups (p < .001). A significant negative correlation was found between mean GSE total score and mean NATQ total score (r = -0.983; p < .001). Mean NATQ total score explained 96.7% of the score obtained from the GSE (R2 = 0.967; p < .001).
CONCLUSION: Individuals with mental disorders had high levels of NATs and low levels of self-efficacy. Given the higher levels of NATs and lower self-efficacy observed among individuals with SUD and schizophrenia, these groups may benefit from additional support and interventions targeting cognitive distortions and self-efficacy.

标题：精神障碍中负性自动思维与自我效能水平的比较
摘要：目的：比较不同精神障碍患者负性自动思维与自我效能水平的差异，并探讨全体样本中负性自动思维与自我效能水平之间的关系。方法：本横断面研究纳入187例在精神科门诊就诊的患者，诊断为双相障碍、抑郁症、精神分裂症及其他精神病性障碍、焦虑障碍和物质使用障碍。采用负性自动思维问卷和一般自我效能量表收集数据。结果：物质使用障碍、精神分裂症及其他精神病性障碍患者的GSE总分低于其他组，NATQ总分高于其他组（p < 0.001）。GSE总分与NATQ总分呈显著负相关（r = -0.983；p < 0.001）。NATQ总分可解释GSE得分的96.7%（R² = 0.967；p < 0.001）。结论：精神障碍患者具有高水平的负性自动思维和低水平的自我效能。鉴于物质使用障碍和精神分裂症患者表现出更高的负性自动思维和更低的自我效能，这些群体可能需要针对认知扭曲和自我效能的额外支持和干预。
关键词：负性自动思维；自我效能；精神障碍；认知扭曲
